title: Bowden Institution inmate dies in custody
article: Correctional Service of Canada is reviewing the death on Tuesday of a 34-year-old Bowden Institution inmate.
Erick Reid began serving an 11-year, six-month sentence on Nov. 6, 2018.
The inmate's next of kin have been notified.
As in all cases involving the death of an inmate, the Correctional Service of Canada (CSC) will review the circumstances. CSC policy requires that the police and the coroner be notified.
Reid was found guilty of manslaughter in November 2018 the death of barber in Hamilton, Ont. on Feb. 16, 2018. He was sentenced to 15 years in prison but given credit for 3 1/2 years of prison time.
Media reports from his trial said that the 40-year-old barber and father of two was shot in the back as he tried to run away from his attackers, Reid and Odain Gardner.
The man who fired the gun, Gardner, was found guilty of first-degree murder in May 2018. That verdict carries an automatic life sentence with no chance of parole for 25 years.
